enDef: the number 19

example.en: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
example.cn: 当时是7点19分。

cn: 需要，要求；缺乏；必要之物
enDef: a situation in which something is necessary, especially something that is not happening yet or is not yet available

example.en: She works to provide for her family’s basic needs.
example.cn: 她工作是为了维持家里的基本生计。

cn: 新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的
enDef: recently made, built, invented, written, designed etc

example.en: the city’s new hospital
example.cn: 市里新建的医院

enDef: a set of large folded sheets of printed paper containing news, articles, pictures, advertisements etc which is sold daily or weekly

example.en: She had read about it in the newspapers.
example.cn: 关于这件事她已经在报纸上看到了。

enDef: the number 90

example.en: America was far richer in the nineties.
example.cn: 90年代的美国要富裕得多。

enDef: no one

example.en: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
example.cn: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

enDef: the 11th month of the year, between October and December

example.en: Too much snow in November.
example.cn: 太多的大雪在十一月。

cn: 名字， 名称； 名声， 名誉
enDef: what someone is called

example.en: Her name is Mandy Wilson.
example.cn: 她的名字是曼迪•威尔逊。

enDef: almost, but not quite or not completely

example.en: It took nearly two hours to get here.
example.cn: 到这里花了将近两小时。

cn: 自然的；物质的；天生的；不做作的
enDef: existing in nature and not caused, made, or controlled by people

example.en: the study of the natural world
example.cn: 对自然界的研究

cn: 好的； 令人愉快的； 友好的， 好心的； 细致的
enDef: pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable

example.en: They’ve got a very nice house.
example.cn: 他们的房子真漂亮。

cn: 数；（杂志等的）期；号码；数字；算术
enDef: a word or sign that represents an amount or a quantity

example.en: They wrote various numbers on a large sheet of paper.
example.cn: 他们在一张大纸上写下了很多不同的数字。

enDef: used to make a word, statement, or question negative

example.en: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
example.cn: 大多数商店要到上午10点才开始营业。

cn: 国家的， 全国的； 民族的； 国有的， 国立的
enDef: related to a whole nation as opposed to any of its parts

example.en: Religion matters very much at a national level.
example.cn: 宗教事务在全国都非常重要。

enDef: the direction that is at the top of a map of the world, above the Equator. It is on the left if you are facing the rising sun

example.en: Which way is north?
example.cn: 哪边是北？

enDef: information about something that has happened recently

example.en: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
example.cn: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

enDef: a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or frightening

example.en: What’s that noise?
example.cn: 那是什么声音？

enDef: in or from the north of a country or area

example.en: a man with a northern accent
example.cn: 带有北方口音的男子

cn: 鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问
enDef: the part of a person’s or animal’s face used for smelling or breathing

example.en: Someone punched him on the nose.
example.cn: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。

enDef: one of nine equal parts of something

example.en: In that region, Chile went from ninth to first, overall, as Chilean mobile web use increased by 3200% over the past year.
example.cn: 智利从这一地区的第九跃升到第一位，因为智利的移动网络用户在过去一年增长了 3200% 。

enDef: the dark part of each 24-hour period when the sun cannot be seen and when most people sleep

example.en: It was a cold moonlit night.
example.cn: 那是个寒冷的月夜。

cn: 笔记；音符；票据；注解；纸币；便笺；照会；调子
enDef: information that a student writes down during a lesson, from a book etc

example.en: Can I borrow your lecture notes?
example.cn: 我能不能借用一下你的课堂笔记？

enDef: 12 o’clock in the daytime

example.en: We met at 12 noon.
example.cn: 我们中午12点见了面。

enDef: if you notice something or someone, you realize that they exist, especially because you can see, hear, or feel them

example.en: He noticed a woman in a black dress sitting across from him.
example.cn: 他看到有位黑衣女子坐在他的对面。

cn: 看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶
enDef: to rest when you have an illness or injury so that it will get better

example.en: Shaw has been nursing an injury, and will not play on Sunday.
example.cn: 肖一直在养伤，星期天将不参加比赛。

enDef: something that is necessary is what you need to have or need to do

example.en: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
example.cn: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

cn: 接下去， 然后； 居后地， 次于
enDef: the next time

example.en: When I next saw her she completely ignored me.
example.cn: 我再次见到她时，她压根儿没有理我。

cn: 没有人；一个也没有；没有任何东西
enDef: not any amount of something or not one of a group of people or things

example.en: I wish I could offer you some cake but there’s none left.
example.cn: 我真想能请你吃些蛋糕，但一点也没剩的了。

cn: 颈， 脖子； 领圈， 领口
enDef: the part of your body that joins your head to your shoulders, or the same part of an animal or bird

example.en: Mike rubbed the back of his neck.
example.cn: 迈克揉了揉后颈。

enDef: your native country, town etc is the place where you were born

example.en: They never saw their native land again.
example.cn: 他们再也没见到故土。

cn: 神经紧张的， 情绪不安的； 神经系统的； 神经性的
enDef: worried or frightened about something, and unable to relax

example.en: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
example.cn: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

enDef: a long thin piece of food made from a mixture of flour, water, and eggs, usually cooked in soup or boiling water

example.en: Serve the meat with rice or noodles.
example.cn: 肉配米饭或面条一起上。

enDef: everything in the physical world that is not controlled by humans, such as wild plants and animals, earth and rocks, and the weather

example.en: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
example.cn: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

enDef: only a short distance away from someone or something

example.en: It’s a beautiful house but it’s 20 miles away from the nearest town.
example.cn: 房子很漂亮，但离最近的城镇也有20英里。

enDef: used when mentioning two things that are not true or possible

example.en: Neither Oleg’s mother nor his father spoke English.
example.cn: 奥列格的父母都不会说英语。

enDef: not at any time, or not once

example.en: He’s never been to Australia.
example.cn: 他从未去过澳大利亚。

enDef: the number 9

example.en: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
example.cn: 他干这份工作才九个月。

enDef: used to give a negative reply to a question, offer, or request

example.en: ‘Are you Italian?’ ‘No, I’m Spanish.’
example.cn: “你是意大利人吗？”“不，我是西班牙人。”

enDef: an act of nodding

example.en: The woman greeted us with a nod of the head.
example.cn: 那个女人向我们点点头打招呼。

enDef: used when mentioning two things that are not true or do not happen

example.en: He can neither read nor write (= he cannot read or write ).
example.cn: 他既不会读也不会写。

enDef: usual, typical, or expected

example.en: A normal working week is 40 hours.
example.cn: 一个正常的工作周是40小时。

enDef: a book made of plain paper on which you can write notes

example.en: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
example.cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一个笔记本和一支钢笔。

enDef: zero

example.en: I owe him nothing.
example.cn: 我不欠他什么。

enDef: You use now to refer to the present time, often in contrast to a time in the past or the future

example.en: She's a widow now.
example.cn: 她现在是一个寡妇。

enDef: the net amount is the final amount that remains after all the other amounts have been taken away

example.en: The net profit (= after taxes, costs etc ) was up 16.3% last month.
example.cn: 上个月净利润增长了16.3%。

enDef: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away

example.en: He might easily have been seen by someone who lived nearby.
example.cn: 他可能很容易被住在附近的人看到。

example.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel.
example.cn: 第十九是毗他希雅，第二十是以西结。

example.en: My neighbor?
example.cn: 我的邻居？

enDef: considering only the bad qualities of a situation, person etc and not the good ones

example.en: students with a negative attitude to school
example.cn: 对上学抱消极态度的学生

cn: 任何地方都不； 无处
enDef: not in any place or to any place

example.en: Nowhere is drug abuse more of a problem than in the US.
example.cn: 没有什么地方的吸毒问题比美国更严重。

enDef: a very thin, pointed steel tube at the end of a syringe, which is pushed into your skin to put a drug or medicine into your body or to take out blood

example.en: She carried hypodermic needles and syringes in her bag.
example.cn: 她包里带着皮下注射针和针筒。

enDef: the process of giving or getting the right type of food for good health and growth

example.en: Nutrition and exercise are essential to fitness and health.
example.cn: 营养和运动是保持健康所必不可少的。

cn: 东北的；向东北的；来自东北的
enDef: The northeast edge, corner, or part of a place is the part which is toward the northeast

example.en: ...a climate like that of our northeast coast.
example.cn: …同我们东北部沿海气候相似的一种气候。

enDef: someone who lives next to you or near you

example.en: One of the neighbors complained about the noise from the party.
example.cn: 有位邻居抱怨聚会太吵。

enDef: the part of a country’s military forces that fights at sea

example.en: the British Navy
example.cn: 英国海军

enDef: the daughter of your brother or sister, or the daughter of your wife’s or husband’s brother or sister

example.en: ...his niece, the daughter of his eldest sister.
example.cn: …他的外甥女，他大姐的女儿。

enDef: a part of your body that is numb is unable to feel anything, for example because you are very cold

example.en: My fingers were so numb I could hardly write.
example.cn: 我的手指麻木得几乎没法写字。

cn: 原子能的；[细胞] 细胞核的；中心的；原子核的
enDef: relating to or involving the nucleus (= central part ) of an atom, or the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is either split or joined with the nucleus of another atom

example.en: France’s reliance on nuclear energy
example.cn: 法国对核能的依赖

cn: 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的
enDef: tidy and carefully arranged

example.en: neat handwriting
example.cn: 工整的笔迹

enDef: a string of jewels, beads etc or a thin gold or silver chain to wear around the neck

example.en: ...a diamond necklace and matching earrings.
example.cn: …一条钻石项链和与之相配的耳环。

enDef: Something that is nonstop continues without any pauses or interruptions

example.en: Many U.S. cities now have nonstop flights to Aspen.
example.cn: 很多美国城市现在都有飞往亚斯本的直飞航班。

enDef: a man’s tie

example.en: Really? I should untie the necktie right now.
example.cn: 真的吗？那我还是赶紧把领带解了。

enDef: the state of being legally a citizen of a particular country

example.en: people of the same nationality
example.cn: 同国籍的人

enDef: the son of your brother or sister, or the son of your husband’s or wife’s brother or sister

example.en: I am planning a 25th birthday party for my nephew.
example.cn: 我正在为侄子筹划他25岁的生日聚会。

enDef: measuring only a small distance from one side to the other, especially in relation to the length

example.en: The stairs were very narrow.
example.cn: 楼梯非常狭窄。

enDef: someone who writes novels

example.en: The key to success as a romantic novelist is absolute belief in your story.
example.cn: 一个浪漫派小说家成功的关键在于对自己故事的绝对信念。

enDef: a place made or chosen by a bird to lay its eggs in and to live in

example.en: a bird’s nest
example.cn: 鸟窝

enDef: happening or existing in every part of the country

example.en: a nationwide search for a missing British tourist
example.cn: 在全国范围内对一名失踪英国游客的搜寻

enDef: a system of lines, tubes, wires, roads etc that cross each other and are connected to each other

example.en: Hungary’s telephone network
example.cn: 匈牙利的电话网

enDef: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics

example.en: His first aim is to get the warring parties back to the negotiating table (= discussing something ).
example.cn: 他的首要目标就是把交战各方拉回到谈判桌上。

cn: 尼龙，[纺] 聚酰胺纤维；尼龙袜
enDef: a strong artificial material that is used to make plastics, clothes, rope etc

example.en: nylon fabric
example.cn: 尼龙织物

example.en: It’s a colorful scene - laborers unload noisily, and small groups of women haggle for the pots of crabs and sardines to sell at village markets.
example.cn: 在这个热闹的环境中，工人喧闹地卸着船，三五成群的妇女正在为一盆盆螃蟹和沙丁鱼讨价还价，以便在村里的鱼市出售。

enDef: an area of a town or city

example.en: She grew up in a quiet neighborhood of Boston.
example.cn: 她是在波士顿一个清静的街区里长大的。

cn: 螺母，螺帽；坚果；难对付的人，难解的问题
enDef: a dry brown fruit inside a hard shell, that grows on a tree

example.en: a pine nut
example.cn: 松子

enDef: morally good or generous in a way that is admired

example.en: It’s very noble of you to spend all your weekends helping the old folk.
example.cn: 你心地真好，周末的时间全都用来帮助老人。

enDef: towards the north

example.en: We sailed northwards.
example.cn: 我们向北航行。

enDef: a country, considered especially in relation to its people and its social or economic structure

example.en: the President’s radio broadcast to the nation
example.cn: 总统对全国的广播讲话

enDef: to fasten something to something else with nails

example.en: Frank put the first plank down and nailed it in place.
example.cn: 弗兰克放下第一块木板，把它钉到位。

enDef: someone or something that is noisy makes a lot of noise

example.en: The kids have been really noisy today.
example.cn: 孩子们今天实在是吵。

cn: 西北的；向西北的；来自西北的
enDef: a northwest wind comes from the northwest

example.en: the northwest suburbs of the city
example.cn: 城市西北部的郊区

enDef: not like anything known before, and unusual or interesting

example.en: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
example.cn: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

enDef: now, compared with what happened in the past

example.en: Nowadays people are rarely shocked by the sex they see on television.
example.cn: 如今人们在电视上看见性爱镜头不太会感到吃惊了。

enDef: a place where young children are taken care of during the day while their parents are at work

example.en: She puts her baby in this nursery and then goes back to work.
example.cn: 她把孩子送到这家托儿所然后回去上班。

enDef: the job or skill of looking after people who are ill, injured, or old

example.en: I’d love to go into nursing.
example.cn: 我很乐意从事护理行业。

enDef: having very little food or money

example.en: a needy family
example.cn: 贫困家庭

example.en: Iterates may be categorized into stable and unstable sets depending on whether a neighborhood under iteration converges or diverges. Some move toward stability, others away.
example.cn: 根据一个受迭代影响的社区是聚合还是发散，迭代可以被归类到稳定和不稳定集。有些转向稳定，有些转离。

cn: 通知， 告知， 报告
enDef: to formally or officially tell someone about something

example.en: The skipper notified the coastguard of the tragedy.
example.cn: 船长通知了海岸警卫队这一灾难。

enDef: To nourish a person, animal, or plant means to provide them with the food that is necessary for life, growth, and good health

example.en: The food she eats nourishes both her and the baby.
example.cn: 她吃的食物为她和婴儿提供营养。

enDef: to fail to look after someone or something properly

example.en: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
example.cn: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

enDef: used when saying the names of the people or things you are referring to

example.en: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
example.cn: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

enDef: not supporting any of the people or groups involved in an argument or disagreement

example.en: I always tried to remain neutral when they started arguing.
example.cn: 他们争论起来的时候我总是努力保持中立。

enDef: food that is nutritious is full of the natural substances that your body needs to stay healthy or to grow properly

example.en: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
example.cn: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。

enDef: A newsstand is a stall in the street or a public place, which sells newspapers and magazines

example.en: Eight new national newspapers have appeared on the newsstands since 1981.
example.cn: 自1981年以来，有八家全国性报纸已在报摊上有售。

cn: 概念， 观念； 意图， 想法， 念头
enDef: an idea, belief, or opinion

example.en: She had no notion what he meant.
example.cn: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

enDef: not wearing any clothes or not covered by clothes

example.en: The children ran naked through the yard.
example.cn: 孩子们光着身子跑过院子。

enDef: a short sleep, especially during the day

example.en: an afternoon nap
example.cn: 午睡

example.en: a nasty temper
example.cn: 坏脾气

enDef: use this to say that something is normal and not surprising

example.en: Naturally, you’ll want to discuss this with your wife.
example.cn: 当然，你一定想和你妻子商量一下这件事。

enDef: a naughty child does not obey adults and behaves badly

example.en: You’re a very naughty boy! Look what you’ve done!
example.cn: 你真是个淘气鬼！瞧你干了些什么！

example.en: The harbour is an important naval base.
example.cn: 该港是一个重要的海军基地。

enDef: the science or job of planning which way you need to go when you are travelling from one place to another

example.en: compasses and other instruments of navigation
example.cn: 罗盘及其他导航仪器

enDef: in a way that cannot be different or be avoided

example.en: The care of old people necessarily involves quite a lot of heavy lifting.
example.cn: 照顾老年人必定要干很多搬重物的活儿。

enDef: when something is necessary

example.en: I’m afraid it’s become a matter of economic necessity.
example.cn: 恐怕这已成了一个经济需求的问题。

enDef: needless troubles, suffering, loss etc are unnecessary because they could easily have been avoided

example.en: The report caused needless anxiety to women who have attended the clinic.
example.cn: 那份报告让去那家诊所就诊过的妇女产生了不必要的忧虑。

enDef: a word for a black person, usually considered offensive

example.en: "I do not accept the Negro as my equal, " Douglas said. "And I deny that he is my brother.
example.cn: “我不会接受黑人与我平等的思想，”道格拉斯说，“而且我拒绝把黑人当成我的兄弟。

enDef: nerves are parts inside your body which look like threads and carry messages between the brain and other parts of the body

example.en: a condition which affects the nerves in the back
example.cn: 影响背部神经的疾病

enDef: in spite of a fact that you have just mentioned

example.en: The news may be unexpected; nevertheless, it is true.
example.cn: 这消息可能是出乎意料的，然而是真实的。

enDef: Newly is used before a past participle or an adjective to indicate that a particular action is very recent, or that a particular state of affairs has very recently begun to exist

example.en: She was young at the time, and newly married.
example.cn: 那时她还年轻，刚结婚。

cn: 噩梦； 可怕的事物， 无法摆脱的恐惧
enDef: a very frightening dream

example.en: a recurring nightmare
example.cn: 一再出现的噩梦

enDef: a gas that has no colour or smell, and that forms most of the Earth’s air. It is a chemical element: symbol N

example.en: Well, we know nitrogen has what?
example.cn: 对于氮气我们知道什么？

enDef: ideas, opinions, statements etc that are not true or that seem very stupid

example.en: ‘I’m a prisoner in my own home.’ ‘Nonsense!’
example.cn: “我在自己家里就像个囚犯。”“胡说！”

enDef: usually

example.en: The journey normally takes about two hours.
example.cn: 这段旅程通常需要大约两小时。

enDef: easy to notice

example.en: Alcohol has a noticeable effect on the body.
example.cn: 酒精对身体有明显的影响。

enDef: a word or group of words that represent a person (such as ‘Michael’, ‘teacher’ or ‘police officer’), a place (such as ‘France’ or ‘school’), a thing or activity (such as ‘coffee’ or ‘football’), or a quality or idea (such as ‘danger’ or ‘happiness’). Nouns can be used as the subject or object of a verb (as in ‘The teacher arrived’ or ‘We like the teacher’) or as the object of a preposition (as in ‘good at football’).

example.en: An adjective must agree with  its noun in mumber and case.
example.cn: 形容词在数和格方面必须符合其所修饰的名词。

enDef: the central part of an atom, made up of neutrons, protons, and other elementary particles

example.en: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
example.cn: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

enDef: a person, thing, or situation that annoys you or causes problems

example.en: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
example.cn: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。

enDef: many

example.en: Numerous attempts have been made to hide the truth.
example.cn: 为掩盖事实作了很多尝试。

cn: 叙述文， 故事； 叙述， 讲述
enDef: a description of events in a story, especially in a novel

example.en: At several points in the narrative the two stories cross.
example.cn: 叙述中两条故事线多次交织在一起。

enDef: a part of an atom that has no electrical charge

example.en: Each atomic cluster is made up of neutrons and protons.
example.cn: 每个原子团簇是由中子和质子组成的。

enDef: important, interesting, excellent, or unusual enough to be noticed or mentioned

example.en: The town is notable for its busy open-air market.
example.cn: 该城镇因其热闹的露天市场而出名。

example.en: the normalization of relations
example.cn: 关系的正常化

enDef: a system of written marks or signs used to represent something such as music, mathematics, or scientific ideas

example.en: Musical notation was conceived for the C major scale and each line and space represents a note in this scale.
example.cn: 乐谱为C大音阶而构思，在这个音阶中的每一个线和间都代表一个音符。

enDef: the act of telling a story
someone who is a member of a group of religious women that live together in a convent

example.en: Mr. Thomas was taught by the Catholic nuns whose school he attended to work and study hard.
example.cn: 托马斯先生受教于天主教修女。在修女开办的学校里他专心工作，刻苦学习。

enDef: the quality of being new, unusual, and interesting

example.en: Many toys have no attraction beyond their novelty value.
example.cn: 许多玩具除了有些新奇感之外，别无吸引力。

enDef: the number 0

example.en: A billion is 1 with 9 noughts after it.
example.cn: 十亿是1后面加9个零。

enDef: official discussions between the repre­sentatives of opposing groups who are trying to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics

example.en: The trader was obstinate in the negotiation.
example.cn: 这个商人在谈判中拗强固执。

enDef: the state of not supporting either side in an argument or war

example.en: Net neutrality, or not?
example.cn: 网络中立或不?

enDef: to officially suggest someone or something for an important position, duty, or prize

example.en: This week one of them will be nominated by the Democratic Party for the presidency of the United States.
example.cn: 本周他们中的一人将被民主党提名为美国总统职位的候选人。

enDef: too slight or unimportant to have any effect

example.en: The damage done to his property was negligible.
example.cn: 对他财产造成的损失微不足道。

enDef: to make it necessary for you to do something

example.en: Lack of money necessitated a change of plan.
example.cn: 由于缺乏资金，只能改变计划。

enDef: expressed or considered in numbers

example.en: a numerical code
example.cn: 数字密码

enDef: the food and other substances that people and other living things need to live, grow, and stay healthy

example.en: lack of proper nourishment
example.cn: 缺乏适当的营养

cn: 尽管如此， 依然， 然而
enDef: in spite of the fact that has just been mentioned

example.en: The region was extremely beautiful. Nonetheless Gerard could not imagine spending the rest of his life there.
example.cn: 那个地区非常漂亮，然而杰拉德却无法想象自己要在那里度过余生。

example.en: Derrida famously, notoriously, said "there is nothing outside the text," right? What he meant by that, of course, is that there's nothing but text.
example.cn: 德里达著名地，恶名昭彰地，说道，文本之外什么都没有“,是吧，当然，他意思就是说，需要考虑的只有文本。

enDef: to sail along a river or other area of water

example.en: The river is too dangerous to navigate.
example.cn: 这河道太危险，不适宜航行。

cn: 名义上的， 有名无实的； 很少的， 象征性的； 名词性的
enDef: officially described as being something, when this is not really true

example.en: the nominal head of the rebellion
example.cn: 这次叛乱名义上的领导人

enDef: a hard silver-white metal that is often combined with other metals, for example to make steel. It is a chemical element: symbol Ni

example.en: a nickel alloy
example.cn: 镍合金

enDef: near the place where you are or the place you are talking about

example.en: The fair attracted hundreds of people from the neighbouring towns and villages.
example.cn: 集市吸引了邻近城镇及村庄的好几百人前来。

cn: 养育， 培育， 滋养
enDef: to feed and take care of a child or a plant while it is growing

example.en: plants nurtured in the greenhouse
example.cn: 在温室里培育的植物

enDef: in a way that is clearly different, important, or unusual

example.en: Emigration has notably increased over the past five years.
example.cn: 在过去五年中，移居国外的人明显增加。

enDef: well known or famous, especially because of some special quality or ability

example.en: a noted author
example.cn: 著名作家

enDef: in spite of something

example.en: Notwithstanding differences, there are clear similarities in all of the world’s religions.
example.cn: 世界上的宗教尽管各不相同，但都有明显的相似之处。

enDef: nothing

example.en: The new machine reduced labour costs to almost nil.
example.cn: 新机器把劳动成本几乎降到零。

cn: 通知， 告示； 通知书
enDef: official information about something

example.en: Names of the dead and injured are being withheld pending notification of relatives.
example.cn: 伤亡者的姓名在通知亲属前不被公布。

enDef: famous or well-known for something bad

example.en: a notorious computer hacker
example.cn: 声名狼藉的电脑黑客

enDef: a name given to someone, especially by their friends or family, that is not their real name and is often connected with what they look like or something they have done

example.en: Stephen earned himself the nickname Hawkeye.
example.cn: 斯蒂芬得了个“鹰眼”的绰号。

enDef: a square piece of cloth or paper used for protecting your clothes and for cleaning your hands and lips during a meal

example.en: ...taking tiny bites of a hot dog and daintily wiping my lips with a napkin.
example.cn: …小口咬着热狗并用餐巾文雅地擦着我的嘴唇。

cn: 幼稚的； 天真的； 轻信的
enDef: not having much experience of how complicated life is, so that you trust people too much and believe that good things will always happen

example.en: a naive young girl
example.cn: 天真的小女孩

enDef: the usual or normal situation, way of doing something etc

example.en: Joyce’s style of writing was a striking departure from the literary norm.
example.cn: 乔伊斯的写作风格与传统的文学风格大相径庭。

enDef: if you feel nostalgic about a time in the past, you feel happy when you remember it, and in some ways you wish that things had not changed

example.en: Seeing those old school photographs has made me feel quite nostalgic.
example.cn: 看到那些学生时代的旧照片，我不禁产生了怀旧之情。

cn: 北欧人的； 北欧国家的
enDef: relating to the northern European countries of Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Iceland, and Finland, or to their people

example.en: the Nordic countries
example.cn: 北欧国家

enDef: a chemical or food that provides what is needed for plants or animals to live and grow

example.en: The plant absorbs nutrients from the soil.
example.cn: 植物从土壤中吸取养分。

enDef: someone who has no experience in a skill, subject, or activity

example.en: The computer course is ideal for novices.
example.cn: 这门计算机课程非常适合初学者。

enDef: harmful or poisonous

example.en: noxious fumes
example.cn: 有毒烟雾

enDef: a very slight, hardly noticeable difference in manner, colour, meaning etc

example.en: He was aware of every nuance in her voice.
example.cn: 他听得出她声音中的每一个细微变化。

enDef: an agreement, contract etc that is null and void has no legal force

example.en: The contract was declared null and void.
example.cn: 该合同被宣布无效。

enDef: to make something lose its effect or value

example.en: Recent inflation could nullify the economic growth of the last several years.
example.cn: 最近的通货膨胀可能会抵消过去数年的经济增长。

example.en: Where children respect a parent and know that he or she demands good behavior in school, even mediocre or loutish teachers can pull off the trick④of producing modestly literate and numerate children.
example.cn: 如果孩子尊重父母，并且知道父母要求自己好好上学，即便是平庸的或是很笨的老师也能够成功地教出一般水平的能读会算的小学生。

cn: 时事通讯， 业务通讯
enDef: a short written report of news about a club, organization etc that is sent regularly to people who are interested

example.en: The society publishes a newsletter twice a year.
example.cn: 该社团一年出版两次简报。

cn: 营养的， 滋养的； 营养物的， 食物的
enDef: relating to the substances in food that help you to stay healthy

example.en: Cooking vegetables for too long lessens their nutritional value.
example.cn: 烹饪蔬菜时间过长有损其营养价值。

example.en: Why don't you go and put it up on the college notice board?
example.cn: 你干嘛不去学校的公告牌上打个广告？

cn: 夜晚的； 夜晚发生的； 夜晚活动的
enDef: an animal that is nocturnal is active at night

example.en: Hamsters are nocturnal creatures.
example.cn: 仓鼠是夜行动物。

enDef: a type of drug which makes you sleep and reduces pain

example.en: The truth of Johnson’s comment was recently brought home to me by the serene calm of a resident who was treating a particularly complicated narcotic-dependent patient.
example.cn: 最近，一位住院医生对待一位异常复杂的麻醉药依赖病人的平静态度让我领会到了塞缪尔.约翰逊这句话的真谛。

enDef: relating to birth

example.en: Green turtles return to their natal island to breed.
example.cn: 绿毛龟回到它们出生的岛上繁殖。

enDef: relating to ships, boats, or sailing

example.en: nautical equipment
example.cn: 航海装备

enDef: the feeling that you have when you think you are going to vomit (= bring food up from your stomach through your mouth )

example.en: I was overcome with a feeling of nausea.
example.cn: 我感到一阵恶心。

cn: (江河、海洋)可航行的，可通航的
enDef: a river, lake etc that is navigable is deep and wide enough for ships to travel on

example.en: ...the navigable portion of the Nile.
example.cn: ...尼罗河的适航河段。

enDef: when something is made to have no effect or be the opposite of what it should be

example.en: Much of what passes for Christianity is a negation of Christ’s teachings.
example.cn: 许多被认为是基督教的东西，和基督的教诲是相悖的。

enDef: failure to take enough care over something that you are responsible for

example.en: negligence in carrying out safety procedures
example.cn: 执行安全程序时的疏忽

cn: 可谈判的，可(通行)商议的；可兑换现金的
enDef: an offer, price, contract etc that is negotiable can be discussed and changed before being agreed on

example.en: Part-time barman required. Hours and salary negotiable.
example.cn: 招聘兼职酒吧男服务员，工作时间及薪金面议。

cn: 神经官能病，精神性神经病
enDef: a mental illness that makes someone unreasonably worried or frightened

example.en: He was anxious to the point of neurosis.
example.cn: 他的忧虑达到了神经机能病症状的程度。

enDef: unreasonably anxious or afraid

example.en: He seemed a neurotic, self-obsessed man.
example.cn: 他似乎是个神经过敏又自恋的人。

enDef: to make a substance chemically neutral

example.en: a medicine that neutralizes the acid in the stomach
example.cn: 能中和胃酸的药

enDef: to eat small amounts of food by taking very small bites

example.en: He nibbled the biscuit cautiously.
example.cn: 他小心地啃着饼干。

cn: 声名狼藉， 臭名昭著
enDef: the state of being famous or well-known for something that is bad or that people do not approve of

example.en: He achieved notoriety as chief counsel to President Nixon in the Watergate break-in.
example.cn: 在水门事件中，他作为尼克松总统的首席辩护律师被搞得声名狼藉。

enDef: the person who tells the story in a book or a play

example.en: The real and reliable narrator should be the narrative ego.
example.cn: 真正的叙述者应为叙述自我，而且是可靠的。

cn: 拘泥小节； 挑剔， 吹毛求疵； 为小事操心； 不断地烦扰
enDef: if something niggles you, you keep worrying about it or feeling annoyed about it and you cannot forget it

example.en: Something’s been niggling her all day.
example.cn: 有什么事烦了她一整天。

enDef: a small detail or point of difference, especially one that is usually considered to be part of the correct way of doing something

example.en: social niceties
example.cn: 社交上的细节

enDef: the group of people in some countries who belong to the highest social class and have titles such as ‘Duke’ or ‘Countess’

example.en: the nobility of his intentions
example.cn: 他崇高的志向

enDef: someone who has been officially suggested for an important position, duty, or prize

example.en: the Democratic Party presidential nominee
example.cn: 民主党被提名的总统候选人

enDef: a feeling that a time in the past was good, or the activity of remembering a good time in the past and wishing that things had not changed

example.en: He looked back on his university days with a certain amount of nostalgia.
example.cn: 他带着一点留恋，回忆起大学时光。

enDef: someone, especially a lawyer, who has the legal power to make a signed statement or document official

example.en: Want to be an assistant judge or notary.
example.cn: 想成为一名助理法官或公证人。

enDef: a V-shaped cut or hole in a surface or edge

example.en: Cut a notch near one end of the stick.
example.cn: 在手杖的一端刻一个V形记号。

enDef: neoclassical art or architecture copies the style of ancient Greece or Rome

example.en: a palace built in a neoclassical style
example.cn: 新古典主义风格的宫殿
